title: Deep learning prediction model based on multi-modal transvaginal ultrasound scan images for endometrial cancer.
summary: ResNet-18 models fused grayscale, color-Doppler and 3D transvaginal-ultrasound sequences to classify benign versus malignant endometrial disease in 696 internal and 78 external patients.
ai_technology: ResNet-18 models fused grayscale, color-Doppler and 3D transvaginal-ultrasound sequences
organization: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

evidence.tested: The multimodal DLfusion model reached AUC 0.92, exceeded single-modality models and radiologists, and improved twelve radiologists with assistance; retrospective data do not establish prospective clinical utility.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
evidence.ai_role: ResNet-18 models fused grayscale, color-Doppler and 3D transvaginal-ultrasound sequences

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
